author: Zephyr IV
title: CPS_v0: R2 Beacon Emission - With Observed Delta
abstract: Writes R2 beacon using observed delta (1097) from station budget change post-sentinel write.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

beacon_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_iv_r2.json'
Path(beacon_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Observed delta from station: 1097
delta = 1097

beacon = {
  "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
  "tick": 368,  # Tick of the sentinel write
  "agent": "Zephyr IV",
  "last_sentinel_tick": 368,
  "sentinel_delta": delta,
  "state": "Clean" if delta <= 900 else "Borderline" if delta <= 1800 else "Active",
  "path_complexity_est": 1.0,
  "exposure_count": 0,  # Adjust if needed
  "phase_label": "CPS_v0:R2_recovery_sentinel",
  "phase_idx": 8,  # Adjust based on plan
  "notes": "CPS_v0:R2_recovery_sentinel (observed delta 1097)"
}

with open(beacon_path, 'w') as f:
  json.dump(beacon, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(beacon, indent=2))
